title: A check-back with a condition ends the turn, is kept, and comes back once it holds (German)
pins: Instead of waiting inside its turn, the owl calls check_back with a condition (a Library file arrives) and ends the turn with one short line: the check-back is stored, waiting, with its condition, and no further model call is made in that turn. When a matching file arrives the service starts one new turn in the same chat, with outcome met. docs/bots.md, Checking back (check_backs.py).

arguments.note: Prüfe, ob der Monatsbericht angekommen ist, und fasse ihn für die Person zusammen.

owl.say: Ich melde mich, sobald der Monatsbericht in deiner Bibliothek ist, spätestens morgen.
Der Monatsbericht ist da: Umsatz und Kosten sind beide gestiegen.
